name: Caltech Fall 2016

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.address: Intersection of Holliston Ave and San Pasqual St, Pasadena, California 91125
venue.details: Winnett Student Center, see website for details

information: This is a US Nationals 2017 qualifying competition. The cost of registration is $4 + 2n, where n is the number of events you sign up for. You must register online - there is no on-site registration. If you are a Caltech student, just show your student ID and the registration fee will be waived. There is a 100-person competitor limit. $1 per competitor goes to the WCA. The fee will be waived for those who are willing to help staff.
